titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Adam to the Flood (ch. 2–8)
about: Gregory, a worker of wonders imprisoned fifteen years in a pit, begins to ponder the greatness of kings. The account goes back to Adam, king of creation, and the envy of Cain and Abel; the line of kings from Seth to Noah; the sin of the sons of Cain; and the Flood.

sentences.t: ፪ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ነገሥት ።
sentences.l: 2. Concerning greatness-of kings
sentences.i: Chapter 2: Concerning the Greatness of Kings
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ takes the construct: ዕበየ ነገሥት 'greatness-of kings' (ዕበይ, construct ዕበየ, followed directly by the dependent noun, no ዘ needed). The Ethiopic numeral ፪ is 2.

sentences.t: ሀቡኬ ፡ ንግባእ ፡ ወነሐስብ ፡ ወንወጥን ፡ ዘናዐቢ ፡ ወናሐጽጽ ፡ እምነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ፡ በሕግ ፡ ወበሥርዐት ፡ በክብር ፡ ወበዕበይ ፡ እምቀዳሚ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደኃሪ ፨
sentences.l: Come-now let-us-return and-let-us-reckon and-let-us-weigh that-which we-make-greater and-we-make-less from-kings-of earth, in-law and-in-ordinance, in-glory and-in-greatness, from-first until last.
sentences.i: Come now, let us return and reckon, and weigh whom we should make greater and whom lesser among the kings of the earth, by law and ordinance, by glory and greatness, from the first to the last.
sentences.n: ሀቡኬ is the plural imperative of ሀበ 'give' used as an exhortation, 'come now'. ንግባእ ወነሐስብ ወንወጥን are 1st plural subjunctives ('let us…') with ን-, joined by ወ-. ናዐቢ and ናሐጽጽ are causatives (አ-stem, 'we make great', 'we make less') of ዐበየ and ሐጽጸ. ዘ- 'that which' is read here as 'whom/what'; እም- 'from' is partitive, 'among the kings of the earth'. The verb ንወጥን (ወጠነ) is 'to examine, weigh' here; compare the end of ch. 2, where አኀዝኩ እወጥን 'I began to weigh' would be tautologous if it meant 'begin'. Nothing in the sentence is a crux, but the exact sense of the first clause is my reading of a compressed syntax. በ- 'in/by' marks the criteria (law, ordinance, glory, greatness). ነገሥተ is the construct plural of ንጉሥ. The ፨ sign closes the unit.

sentences.t: ተንሥአ ፡ ጎርጎርዮስ ፡ ገባሬ ፡ መንክር ፡ ዘተወድየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍቅረ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ፲ወ፭ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምንዳቤ ፤
sentences.l: Arose Gregory, worker-of wonder, who was-put into pit for love-of witness-of Christ, 15 years, in affliction;
sentences.i: There arose Gregory, the worker of wonders, who was thrown into the pit for love of the witness of Christ, for fifteen years, in affliction;
sentences.n: Gregory (ጎርጎርዮስ) is the 'worker of wonders' of the Armenian church; the Armenian king in the next lines points to Gregory the Illuminator, who was held in a pit by King Tiridates. The identification is an inference from context; the text itself gives only the name and the epithet. ገባሬ መንክር 'worker-of wonder' is a construct. ዘተወድየ is ዘ- 'who' plus the passive (ተ-stem) of ወደየ 'put, cast'. ግብ 'pit'. ፍቅረ ስምዐ ክርስቶስ is a chain: love-of witness-of Christ; ስምዕ (witness, testimony) is also the word for martyrdom, so it means love of confessing Christ. ፲ወ፭ is 10 and 5, fifteen; ዓመተ 'years' stands in the accusative of duration.

sentences.t: ውእቱ ፡ ይቤ ፤
sentences.l: he he-said;
sentences.i: He said:
sentences.n: ውእቱ ይቤ 'he said' (ይቤ is the defective verb ብሀለ, used for 'says/said'). The speech begins with the next unit.

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ሀለውኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብ ፡ ኀለይኩ ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ እበዱ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ አርማንያ ፡ ወእቤ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ኅሊናየ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ዕበዮሙ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ሰራዊትኑ ፡ ወሚመ ፡ በክብረ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወሚመ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ሢመተ ፡ አህጉር ፤
sentences.l: While I-was in pit I-pondered concerning this matter and-concerning his-folly of-king-of Armenia, and-I-said, according-to my-thought, what (is) their-greatness: in-multitude-of his-army? or in-glory-of goods-of world? or in-multitude-of appointment-of cities?
sentences.i: While I was in the pit I pondered this matter, and the madness of the king of Armenia, and I said, as far as my mind could judge: in what does their greatness lie? In the size of their armies? Or in the glory of worldly goods? Or in the number of governorships over cities?
sentences.n: እንዘ + perfect gives a circumstantial 'while I was'. ሀለውኩ and ኀለይኩ are 1st singular perfects (ሀሎ 'be', ኀለየ 'ponder, think'). በእንተዝ 'concerning this'. በእንተ እበዱ ለንጉሠ አርማንያ is the Geʿez way of expressing a possessor after a suffixed noun: 'his madness, of the king of Armenia' (suffix -u anticipating ለ + owner). The tradition behind it is King Tiridates' madness. መጠነ 'according to the measure of'. The enclitic -ኑ in ሰራዊትኑ marks a question, and ወሚመ is 'or'. ሢመተ አህጉር is 'appointment-of cities'; I take it as the offices or governorships given over cities; the exact sense of ሢመት here is not certain.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ኀሊይየ ፡ ለለ ፡ ተረፈ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ የሀውከኒ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ ኅሊናየ ፡ ወእኄሊ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ወአኀዝኩ ፡ እወጥን ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-this my-pondering, each remainder-of my-prayer, troubles-me again, my-thought; and-I-ponder concerning greatness-of kings, and-I-began I-weigh.
sentences.i: And this pondering of mine, at the close of each of my prayers, troubles my mind again, and I think about the greatness of kings, and I began to weigh it.
sentences.n: ለለ ተረፈ ጸሎትየ is uncertain. ለለ is a distributive 'each, every', and ተረፈ 'remainder' suggests 'in each remainder (the end) of my prayer'; the sense I give, 'at the close of each prayer', is a guess from context. የሀውከኒ is 'it troubles me' (3rd masc. imperfect ሀወከ with object suffix -ኒ 'me'). አኀዝኩ እወጥን is አኀዘ 'begin' plus an asyndetic subjunctive 'I began (that) I weigh'. The ፨ ፨ ፨ closes the paragraph, as in the source.

sentences.t: ፫ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ አዳም ።
sentences.l: 3. Concerning kingdom-of Adam
sentences.i: Chapter 3: Concerning the Kingdom of Adam
sentences.n: Chapter heading; መንግሥተ is the construct of መንግሥት 'kingdom'.

sentences.t: ወእምአዳም ፡ አልዐልኩ ፡ ወእቤ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በአማን ፡ ዘሎቱ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ወእምታሕቴሁ ፡ ሤሞ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘፈጠረ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-Adam I-lifted(-my-thought) and-I-said: King (is) God in-truth, to-whom it-is-fitting praise; and from-under-him he-appointed-him Adam king over all that he-created;
sentences.i: And I took up my thought from Adam, and said: God is in truth the King, to whom praise is due; and under himself he appointed Adam king over all that he created;
sentences.n: አልዐልኩ is 'I raised, lifted up' (1st singular perfect, causative stem); the object is left unspoken, so 'my thought' is my supply, and the clause is uncertain. ዘሎቱ ይደሉ 'to whom it is fitting' (ይደሉ 'it is fitting, due'). ወእምታሕቴሁ 'and from beneath him': Adam's kingship is subordinate. ሤሞ is the perfect of ሠየመ 'appoint' with the object suffix -o 'him'; ለአዳም is the object restated with ለ-. ዘፈጠረ 'that which he created'. The idea: Adam as king of creation, Genesis 1:26-28 and Psalm 8, which is quoted in ch. 8.

sentences.t: ወበዕልወቱ ፡ አውፅኦ ፡ እምገነት ፡ በኂጠተ ፡ ከይሲ ፡ በምክረ ፡ ዲያብሎስ ፡ ወበውእቱ ፡ ዜና ፡ ሐዘን ፡ ተወልደ ፡ ቃየን ፤
sentences.l: And-in-his-transgression he-brought-out-him from-garden by-sin-of serpent, by-counsel-of devil; and-in that account-of sorrow was-born Cain;
sentences.i: And through his transgression he expelled him from the garden, by the sin of the serpent and the counsel of the Devil; and in that story of sorrow Cain was born;
sentences.n: Genesis 3: the expulsion from the garden (ገነት). ዕልወት is 'perversity, transgression'. አውፅኦ is አውፅአ 'he brought out' + -o 'him'. ኂጠተ is a spelling variant of ኀጢአተ 'sin' (accusative or construct); the chain ኂጠተ ከይሲ 'sin-of serpent' is a construct. The sense of ዜና ሐዘን 'account/news of sorrow' is loose; I take ዜና as 'story, affair'. Genesis 4:1 records Cain's birth.

sentences.t: ወርእዮ ፡ አዳም ፡ ለቃየን ፡ እሱረ ፡ ገጽ ፡ ፀዋግ ፡ ራእዩ ፡ ሐዘነ ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ተወልደ ፡ አቤል ፤
sentences.l: And-saw-him Adam — Cain — fettered of-face, dark his-appearance, in-sorrow; and again was-born Abel;
sentences.i: And Adam saw Cain, with a bound and gloomy face, dark in his appearance, sorrowful; and then Abel was born;
sentences.n: ርእዮ ... ለቃየን: the object suffix -o 'him' is repeated by the noun with ለ-, a regular doubling. እሱረ ገጽ 'bound-of face' (a passive participle in a construct) is an idiom for a grim or downcast face; ፀዋግ 'dark' (cf. Genesis 4:5, Cain's fallen face). The exact connotation of ፀዋግ is not certain. ወካዕበ 'and again'.

sentences.t: ወርእዮ ፡ አዳም ፡ ለአቤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ራእዩ ፡ ወፍሡሕ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ወራሴ ፡ መንግሥትየ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-saw-him Adam — Abel — that good his-appearance and-glad his-face, said: this (is) my-son and-heir-of my-kingdom.
sentences.i: And Adam saw Abel, that his appearance was good and his face cheerful, and said: this is my son and the heir of my kingdom.
sentences.n: ከመ here introduces the content of what Adam saw ('that'). ፍሡሕ 'glad, cheerful'. ወራሴ መንግሥትየ is a construct chain with a suffix on the last noun: 'heir of my kingdom'. Adam's choice of Abel as heir sets up the envy of ch. 4. The ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ run closes ch. 3 in the source.

sentences.t: ፬ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ቅንአት ።
sentences.l: 4. Concerning envy
sentences.i: Chapter 4: Concerning Envy
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ቅንአት is 'envy, jealousy' (also 'zeal'); the verb ቀንአ below is the same root.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ልህቁ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ቀንአ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ሰይጣን ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ይእተ ፡ ቅንአተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልበ ፡ ቃየን ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-grew-up together, envied against-him Satan, and-put that envy into heart-of Cain;
sentences.i: And when they had grown up together, Satan envied Abel, and put that envy into the heart of Cain;
sentences.n: ሶበ 'when' with the perfect ልህቁ 'they grew up' (ልህቀ). ቀንአ ላዕሌሁ 'he envied against him' (ላዕሌሁ = ላዕለ + -hu). ወወደየ ... ውስተ 'and put ... into'; ይእተ is the feminine demonstrative 'that', agreeing with ቅንአት. ልበ ቃየን 'heart-of Cain' is a construct. The envy comes from Satan, a repeated motif in this chapter.

sentences.t: ቀዳሚ ፡ ቅንአቱ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አቡነ ፡ አዳም ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ ዝውእቱ ፡ ብሩሀ ፡ ገጽ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ወራሴ ፡ መንግሥትየ ፤
sentences.l: First his-envy concerning word-of our-father Adam, which he-said: this-one-who bright-of face, let-him-be heir-of my-kingdom;
sentences.i: The first cause of his envy was the word of our father Adam, who said: let this one, bright of face, be the heir of my kingdom;
sentences.n: ቀዳሚ ቅንአቱ 'first (was) his envy' is a nominal sentence with no copula. ዝውእቱ 'he who is this'. ብሩሀ ገጽ is 'bright-of face' (construct), matching Abel's cheerful face in ch. 3. ይኩን 'let him be' (3rd masc. jussive). The three causes of envy (first, second, third) run through units 13 to 16.

sentences.t: ወበዳግምሳ ፡ ቅንአቱ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እኅቱ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ራእያ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተወልደት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቃየን ፡ ወተውህበት ፡ ለአቤል ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይብዝኁ ፡ ወይምልእዋ ፡ ለምድር ፤
sentences.l: And-in-the-second-indeed his-envy concerning his-sister, good her-appearance, who was-born with Cain, and-was-given to-Abel, as commanded God: let-them-multiply and-let-them-fill-her the-earth;
sentences.i: And the second cause of his envy was his sister, beautiful in appearance, who had been born with Cain and was given to Abel, as God commanded: let them multiply and fill the earth;
sentences.n: ዳግምሳ 'second' with the contrastive enclitic -ሳ. The twin-sister story is not in Genesis; it is in later Jewish and Christian tradition (Jubilees 4 and others) which explains whom Cain and Abel married. ተወልደት and ተውህበት are 3rd fem. passives. The command is Genesis 1:28, 'be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth'; ይምልእዋ ለምድር has the object suffix -ዋ 'her' anticipating ለምድር 'the earth' (feminine).

sentences.t: ወእንተ ፡ ተወልደትሰ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አቤል ፡ ትመስል ፡ ርእየተ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለቃየን ፡ ወአስተኃለፈ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-who was-born-indeed with Abel resembled in-look-of face Cain, and-he-exchanged their-father and-gave-them;
sentences.i: But the one who was born with Abel resembled Cain in the look of her face, and their father exchanged them and gave them over;
sentences.n: ተወልደትሰ: the enclitic -ሰ marks the contrast with the other sister. ትመስል ርእየተ ገጹ ለቃየን is 'she resembled the sight-of his face, to Cain'; the grammar of ትመስል (መሰለ) with ለ is a little awkward and my reading is the natural one, not certain. አስተኃለፈ is the reciprocal causative of ሐለፈ 'to pass', so 'to exchange'. The final ወወሀቦሙ 'and he gave them' leaves the recipients implicit: the brothers received the sisters crosswise.

sentences.t: ወሣልስ ፡ ቅንአቱ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘሦዑ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ወተወክፈ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ አቤል ፡ ወአስቆረረ ፡ መሥዋዕቶ ፡ ለቃየን ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ቅንአት ፡ ቀተሎ ፤
sentences.l: And-third his-envy concerning that-which they-sacrificed both-of-them, and-accepted God offering-of Abel and-made-loathsome his-offering to-Cain; and for-this envy he-killed-him;
sentences.i: The third cause of his envy was that both of them made offerings, and God accepted the offering of Abel but rejected the offering of Cain; and because of this envy he killed him;
sentences.n: ዘሦዑ is ዘ + ሠውዑ 'they sacrificed' (ሠውዐ); ክልኤሆሙ 'both of them'. ተወክፈ 'accepted'. አስቆረረ is the causative of ቈረረ: 'he made it loathsome, cold to him'; I render 'rejected'. The root ቈረረ returns in ch. 8, where it is harder. Genesis 4:3-8.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ቀትለ ፡ አኀው ፡ እምቃዳሚ ፡ ተፈጥረ ፡ በቅንአተ ፡ ሳይጣን ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወሶበ ፡ ቀተለ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ርዑደ ፡ ወድንጉፀ ፡ ወምኑነ ፡ በኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወበኀበ ፡ እግዚኡ ፡ ወተወልደ ፡ ሴት ፡ ወርእዮ ፡ አዳም ፡ ይቤ ፤
sentences.l: For killing-of brothers from-the-first was-created through-envy-of Satan against sons-of Adam; and when he-killed his-brother he-became trembling and-stunned and-rejected before his-father and-before his-lord; and-was-born Seth, and-saw-him Adam, he-said:
sentences.i: For the killing of brothers was brought about from the beginning by Satan's envy against the sons of Adam; and when he killed his brother he became a trembler and stunned and cast out, before his father and before his lord; and Seth was born, and Adam saw him and said:
sentences.n: ቀትለ አኀው 'killing-of brothers' is a construct. ተፈጥረ 'was created' (passive); the sense is that fratricide was set going. ኮነ ... ርዑደ ወድንጉፀ 'he became trembling and stunned' with accusative predicates; compare Genesis 4:12, where the Greek and Ethiopic have Cain as 'groaning and trembling'. ምኑነ 'rejected, abhorred' (ምኑን). በኀበ 'in the presence of, with'. እግዚኡ 'his lord' is probably God. Genesis 4:25 records Seth's birth.

sentences.t: ይእዜኬ ፡ ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወወሀበኒ ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ በንስሓ ፡ ኣቃርቦ ፡ ዋርስየ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ወውእቱሰ ፡ ቀታሌ ፡ ዋርስየ ፡ በ፱ ፡ ትውልዱ ፡ ትደመሰስ ፡ ስሙ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: Now-indeed has-had-mercy-on-me God and-has-given-me brightness-of my-face; in-repentance I-will-offer-him, my-heir, this one; and-that-one-indeed, killer-of my-heir, in-9 his-generations will-be-blotted-out his-name.
sentences.i: Now God has had mercy on me and has given me the brightness of my face. In repentance I will offer him, this my heir; and as for that other, the killer of my heir, within nine of his generations his name will be blotted out.
sentences.n: ይእዜኬ 'now indeed'. ተሣሀለኒ is 'he had mercy on me' (ተሣሀለ is a deponent form with an object suffix). ብርሃነ ገጽየ 'brightness-of my-face' echoes Abel's bright face and is uncertain: it may refer to the restoration of the heir. ኣቃርቦ is the 1st singular imperfect of አቅረበ 'offer, bring near' with the suffix -o 'him'; the object is then repeated: ዋርስየ ዝንቱ 'my heir, this one'. በንስሓ 'in repentance' could attach to the preceding clause ('with brightness of face, through repentance') and the punctuation of the sentence is uncertain. ቀታሌ ዋርስየ is 'killer-of my-heir' (Cain, killer of Abel). በ፱ ትውልዱ is 'in nine (of) his generations'; whether it means a span of nine or the ninth generation is unclear. ትደመሰስ ስሙ 'his name will be blotted out' is a passive of ደምሰሰ, the verb used of the Flood in ch. 8.

sentences.t: ፭ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ሴት ።
sentences.l: 5. Concerning kingdom-of Seth
sentences.i: Chapter 5: Concerning the Kingdom of Seth
sentences.n: Chapter heading. The chapter is a king-list of the patriarchs of Genesis 5, treated as a line of kings.

sentences.t: ወአዕረፈ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ሴት ፡ በጽድቅ ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Adam, and-reigned Seth in-righteousness;
sentences.i: And Adam rested, and Seth reigned in righteousness;
sentences.n: አዕረፈ 'rested' is the standard Geʿez word for 'died' (a peaceful death), as in the Church's idiom. Genesis 5:5 gives Adam's death. ነግሠ 'he reigned' (ነግሠ, from ንጉሥ). Seth is ሴት; the pattern 'X rested and Y reigned' repeats through this chapter and shows the succession of Genesis 5 as a line of kings.

sentences.t: ወአዕረፈ ፡ ሴት ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ሄኖስ ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Seth, and-reigned Enosh;
sentences.i: And Seth rested, and Enosh reigned;
sentences.n: Enosh is ሄኖስ (Genesis 5:6-11). The same pattern; the line continues.

sentences.t: ወአእረፈ ፡ ሄኖስ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ቃይናን ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Enosh, and-reigned Kenan;
sentences.i: And Enosh rested, and Kenan reigned;
sentences.n: Kenan is ቃይናን (Genesis 5:9-14). Note that here አእረፈ is written with ʾ-initial አ, not ዐ (አዕረፈ); a spelling variant in the source.

sentences.t: ወአእረፈ ፡ ቃይናን ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ መላልኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Kenan, and-reigned Mahalalel;
sentences.i: And Kenan rested, and Mahalalel reigned;
sentences.n: Mahalalel is መላልኤል (Genesis 5:12-17). Same pattern.

sentences.t: ወአዕረፈ ፡ መላልኤል ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ያሮድ ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Mahalalel, and-reigned Jared;
sentences.i: And Mahalalel rested, and Jared reigned;
sentences.n: Jared is ያሮድ (Genesis 5:15-20).

sentences.t: ወአዕረፈ ፡ ያሮድ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ሄኖክ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኀብኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይርአዮ ፡ ለሞት ፡ ወሀሎ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በሥጋሁ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ተከብተ ፡ ሄኖክ ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ማቱሳላ ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Jared, and-reigned Enoch in-righteousness, and-he-feared God, and-he-hid-him that not he-see death; and-he-was king in-his-body in-land-of living; and-after was-hidden Enoch, reigned Methuselah;
sentences.i: And Jared rested, and Enoch reigned in righteousness, and feared God, and God hid him so that he should not see death; and he was a king in his body in the land of the living; and after Enoch was hidden away, Methuselah reigned;
sentences.n: Enoch is ሄኖክ (Genesis 5:21-24). ወፈርሆ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'and he feared God': ፈርሆ is the verb with a suffix, the object repeated with ለ-. ኀብኦ is 'he hid him' (subject God); ከመ ኢይርአዮ ለሞት 'that he not see death' echoes Hebrews 11:5 (Genesis 5:24, 'God took him'). ብሔረ ሕያዋን 'land-of the-living' is a construct (Psalm 27:13); in tradition it names the place where Enoch was taken in the flesh. ተከብተ 'was hidden' is a passive form I could not match certainly to a Dillmann headword; the sense is clear from the earlier ኀብኦ. Methuselah is ማቱሳላ (Genesis 5:25-27).

sentences.t: ወአዕረፈ ፡ ማቱሳላ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ላሜኅ ፤
sentences.l: And-rested Methuselah, and-reigned Lamech;
sentences.i: And Methuselah rested, and Lamech reigned;
sentences.n: Lamech is ላሜኅ (Genesis 5:28-31); the father of Noah.

sentences.t: ወአዕረፈ ፡ ላሜኅ ፡ ወነግሠ ፡ ኖሕ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወአሥመሮ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ግብሩ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-rested Lamech, and-reigned Noah in-righteousness, and-he-pleased God in-all his-work.
sentences.i: And Lamech rested, and Noah reigned in righteousness, and pleased God in all his works.
sentences.n: Noah is ኖሕ (Genesis 5:29-32; 6:9). አሥመሮ is the causative አሥመረ 'he pleased' with the suffix -o 'him', repeated by ለእግዚኣብሔር. ግብሩ 'his work(s)', from ግብር; the ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ run closes ch. 5.

sentences.t: ፮ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ቃየን ።
sentences.l: 6. Concerning sin-of Cain
sentences.i: Chapter 6: Concerning the Sin of Cain
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ኀጢአተ ቃየን 'sin-of Cain', construct.

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ርጉም ፡ ቀታሌ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ቃየን ፡ አብዝኃ ፡ ለእከይ ፡ ወዘርኡኒ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ እለ ፡ አምዕዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በእከዮሙ ፡ ወአልቦሙ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ ፡ ወኢኀለይዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፈጣሪሆሙ ፡ ወኢጸለዩ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወኢተጋነዩ ፡ ወኢሰአልዎ ፡ ወኢተቀንዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በፍርሀት ፤
sentences.l: And-he-indeed (was) accursed, killer-of his-brother, Cain: he-multiplied evil, and-his-seed-also likewise, who provoked God by-their-evils, and-not-to-them fear-of God before their-eyes, and-not they-thought-of-him as their-creator, and-not they-prayed to-him, and-not they-bowed, and-not they-asked-him, and-not they-served for-him in-fear;
sentences.i: He was accursed, Cain, the killer of his brother; he multiplied evil, and his seed likewise, they who provoked God by their wickedness, and had no fear of God before their eyes; and they did not think of him as their creator, nor pray to him, nor bow down, nor ask of him, nor serve him in fear;
sentences.n: ርጉም is 'cursed'; ቀታሌ እኁሁ 'killer-of his-brother' is a construct. አብዝኃ is 3rd masc. 'he multiplied'; ለእከይ marks 'evil' as its object (ለ- as an object marker). ዘርኡኒ: ዘርእ 'seed' with -u 'his' and -ኒ 'also'. እለ አምዕዕዎ 'who provoked him' (አምዐዐ 'to anger'). አልቦሙ 'they have not', 'they had no'. ፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሔር ቅድመ አዕይንቲሆሙ echoes Psalm 36:1 (35:2): 'there is no fear of God before their eyes'. The string of ኢ- negatives is a litany: ኀለየ (think), ጸለየ (pray), ተጋነየ (bow/serve), ሰአለ (ask), ተቀንየ (serve). The exact shade of ተጋነየ is 'bow down, do homage' (uncertain between 'bow' and 'confess').

sentences.t: ዘእንበለ ፡ ዘይበልዑ ፡ ወይሰትዩ ፡ ወይዘፍኑ ፡ ወይትዋነዩ ፡ በመሰንቆ ፡ ወበማሕሌት ፡ ወበዝሙት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ወዘእንበለ ፡ መስፈርት ፡ ወዘእንበለ ፡ ሥርዐት ፡ ወበዝኀ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቃየን ፡ እስከ ፡ በትዕቢተ ፡ ዝሙቶሙ ፡ አግብኡ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ አድግ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈረስ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ በቅለ ፡ ዘኢአዘዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: Except that-which they-eat and-they-drink and-they-dance and-they-sing with-lyre and-with-chant and-with-fornication, without law and-without measure and-without ordinance; and-increased their-evils for-sons-of Cain, until in-pride-of their-fornication they-brought seed-of donkey to horse, and-there-was a-growth which not commanded God;
sentences.i: They did nothing but eat and drink and dance and sing to the lyre and in chants and in fornication, without law and without restraint and without order; and the evils of the sons of Cain grew until, in the pride of their fornication, they brought the seed of the donkey to the horse, and there came a growth that God had not commanded;
sentences.n: ዘእንበለ ዘይበልዑ 'except that which they eat': 'apart from eating, drinking…' they did nothing else. መሰንቆ is the one-string lyre; ማሕሌት 'chant' is a liturgical word, here applied to the sons of Cain's revels. CRUX: ዘርአ አድግ ኀበ ፈረስ 'the seed of an ass to a horse'. I read it as the breeding of donkeys with horses (mules), a mixing of kinds that God had not commanded, and the next unit compares it to believers marrying unbelievers. The idiom አግብአ ... ኀበ 'bring to' is plausible but I did not find it in Dillmann in this sense. በቅለ 'a sprout, a growth' (the offspring). ዘኢአዘዘ 'which he did not command'. መስፈርት 'measure, restraint'.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሁቡ ፡ ውሉዶሙ ፡ መሀይምናን ፡ ለከሓድያን ፡ ወይከውኑ ፡ ውሉዶሙ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ግሙራ ፡ ርኩሳን ፡ መንፈቆሙ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ወመንፈቆሙ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ እኩያን ፤
sentences.l: As those-who give their-children, believers, to-unbelievers, and-become their-children seed [ግሙራ] unclean, half-of-them good and-half-of-them seed-of evil-ones;
sentences.i: As with those who give their children, who are believers, to unbelievers, and their children become a mixed and unclean seed, half of them good and half of them an evil seed;
sentences.n: CRUX: ዘርአ ግሙራ ርኩሳን. ግሙር is 'whole, complete' and ግሙራ would be 'wholly', which conflicts with 'half of them good'; 'mixed' is my guess from the context and is uncertain. መሀይምናን 'believers' (plural of መሃይምን) and ከሓድያን 'unbelievers, apostates' (plural of ከሓዲ) are the two parties. እለ ይሁቡ is 'those who give' (relative ዘ plural + imperfect). መንፈቆሙ 'half of them' (መንፈቅ 'half' + -homu). The simile shows the sense of the donkey and horse image: the mingling of the chosen and the unchosen line.

sentences.t: ወእለ ፡ ገብርዋ ፡ ለእኪት ፡ ጽኑሕ ፡ ደይኖሙ ፡ ወንቡር ፡ ጌጋዮሙ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-those-who did evil — firm (is) their-judgment and-abiding their-fault.
sentences.i: And as for those who did evil, their judgment is firm and their guilt remains.
sentences.n: ገብርዋ ለእኪት 'they did (the) evil' (ገብርዋ 'they did it', with ለእኪት 'the evil one' as the object). ጽኑሕ 'firm, strong', ደይን 'judgment', ንቡር 'standing, fixed', ጌጋይ 'fault, error'. The ፨ ፨ ፨ run closes ch. 6.

sentences.t: ፯ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኖሕ ።
sentences.l: 7. Concerning Noah
sentences.i: Chapter 7: Concerning Noah
sentences.n: Chapter heading.

sentences.t: ወኖሕሰ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ ይፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወየዐቅብ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ወዘነገርዎ ፡ አበዊሁ ፡ ሕገ ፡ እምአዳም ፡ ዓሥር ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ኖሕ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይዜከር ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ወየዐቅብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ እምዝሙት ፡ ወይጌሥጽ ፡ ደቂቆ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይደመሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቃየን ፡ መማዕሊይ ፡ ዕቡይ ፡ ናፋቄ ፡ መንግሥት ፤
sentences.l: And-Noah-indeed (was) righteous: he-feared God and-kept righteousness, and-that-which told-him his-fathers — law — from Adam, ten generations, he-himself Noah remembering and-doing good and-keeping his-body from fornication and-admonishing his-sons that-not they-be-joined with sons-of Cain, victors, proud, longers-for kingdom;
sentences.i: Noah, however, was righteous: he feared God and kept righteousness, and the law that his fathers had told him, from Adam for ten generations; Noah himself remembered it and did good and kept his body from fornication, and admonished his sons not to be joined to the sons of Cain, who were conquerors, proud, and eager for power;
sentences.n: Noah is described with the Genesis 6:9 phrase 'righteous'. ይፈርሆ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'he feared God' (object suffix and repeated ለ-); ዘነገርዎ አበዊሁ ሕገ 'what his fathers told him, the law' (ዘ + ነገርዎ with -o 'him', ሕገ in apposition). ዓሥር ትውልድ 'ten generations' is the span of Genesis 5 from Adam to Noah. ለሊሁ ኖሕ 'Noah himself'. እንዘ ይዜከር 'remembering' is a circumstantial clause (ዘከረ). ይጌሥጽ 'admonishes' (ገሠጸ). ከመ ኢይደመሩ 'that they not be joined' (ደመረ 'join'). The three epithets for the sons of Cain are uncertain: መማዕሊይ (I read as 'conquerors', from ሞዐለ), ዕቡይ 'proud', and ናፋቄ መንግሥት 'seeking/longing for kingdom' (ናፋቄ I could not confirm in Dillmann).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ በምክረ ፡ ዲያብሎስ ፡ ዘአሥረጻ ፡ ለእከይ ፡ ሖረ ፡ ወመሀሮሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘጸልኦ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: For by-counsel-of Devil, he-who made-sprout the-evil went and-taught-them all that hated God;
sentences.i: For by the Devil's counsel, the one who made evil sprout went and taught them everything that God hates;
sentences.n: ዘአሥረጻ ለእከይ is 'who made it sprout, namely evil' (አሥረጸ, the causative of ሠረጸ 'sprout', with the feminine object suffix -ሃ). The one who 'went' is not named: Cain or the Devil himself. The text does not say, and I leave the subject unnamed. ዘጸልኦ እግዚኣብሔር 'what God hated' (ጸልአ with the suffix -o).

sentences.t: ትዕቢተ ፡ ትዝኅርተ ፡ ትዝውፍተ ፡ ሐሜተ ፡ ውዴተ ፡ ወማሕላ ፡ በሐሰት ፤
sentences.l: Pride, [ትዝኅርተ], [ትዝውፍተ], slander, [ውዴተ], and-oath in-falsehood;
sentences.i: pride, haughtiness, boasting, slander, [ውዴተ], and false oaths;
sentences.n: A list of vices in the accusative, governed by መሀሮሙ 'he taught them' in the previous unit. ትዕቢት 'pride', ሐሜት 'slander', ማሕላ 'oath'. UNCERTAIN: ትዝኅርት and ትዝውፍት look like rare abstract nouns, probably of pride and boasting, and ውዴት is unclear to me (I leave it unrendered in the translation line); 'haughtiness, boasting' are guesses from their position in the list.

sentences.t: ወፈድፋደሰ ፡ በእከየ ፡ ዝሙቶሙ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ወሥርዐት ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ያረኴስ ፡ ቢጾ ፡ ወአንስት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አንስት ፡ ይገብራ ፡ ኀሳረ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-especially in-the-evil-of their-fornication, without law and-ordinance: man upon man defiles his-fellow, and-women upon women work ruin.
sentences.i: And most of all, in the wickedness of their fornication, outside law and order: men defile one another, and women work ruin upon women.
sentences.n: ወፈድፋደሰ 'and especially' (ፈድፋደ with -ሰ). ብእሲ ላዕለ ብእሲ ያረኴስ ቢጾ 'man upon man defiles his fellow' (ቢጽ 'fellow, neighbour'). ይገብራ is 3rd fem. plural imperfect, 'they (women) do', so the subject is አንስት 'women'; ኀሳር 'ruin, loss'. The sins are those of Leviticus 18 and Romans 1:26-27. The ፨ ፨ ፨ run closes ch. 7.

sentences.t: ፰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ አይኅ ።
sentences.l: 8. Concerning flood
sentences.i: Chapter 8: Concerning the Flood
sentences.n: Chapter heading; አይኅ is 'flood, deluge'.

sentences.t: ወኮነ ፡ ዝግብር ፡ እኩየ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-was this-deed evil before God;
sentences.i: And this deed was evil before God;
sentences.n: ዝግብር is ዝ 'this' joined to ግብር 'deed', written as one word. Compare Genesis 6:5-6, 11.

sentences.t: ወውእቱኒ ፡ ደምሰሶሙ ፡ በማየ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ዘይቈርር ፡ እምነ ፡ አስሐቲያ ፡ አርኀወ ፡ ኀዋኅወ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወወረደ ፡ አስራበ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ወተርኅወ ፡ አንቅዕት ፡ ዘመትሕተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወተከሥተ ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ምድር ፤
sentences.l: And-he-also destroyed-them with-water-of flood, which [ይቈርር] from [አስሐቲያ]; he-opened windows-of heaven, and-descended torrents-of flood, and-were-opened springs which beneath earth, and-were-uncovered springs-of flood upon earth;
sentences.i: And he destroyed them, too, with the waters of the Flood, which turn in loathing from those who led her astray (?); he opened the windows of heaven, and the torrents of the Flood came down, and the springs beneath the earth were opened, and springs of the Flood were laid bare upon the earth;
sentences.n: CRUX: ዘይቈርር እምነ አስሐቲያ. ዘ- relative on ማየ አይኅ; ይቈርር is from ቈረረ 'be cold, loathsome' (the same root as አስቆረረ in ch. 4); እምነ 'from'; አስሐቲያ is probably አስሐቲ 'one who leads astray' plus the feminine suffix, 'her deceiver(s)' (the earth's). My reading 'which turn in loathing from her deceivers' is a guess; another possibility is that the water 'cuts off' the deceivers. ደምሰሶሙ 'he destroyed them' (ደምሰሰ 'blot out', as in Cain's name being blotted out in ch. 4). The scene follows Genesis 7:11: ኀዋኅወ ሰማይ 'windows of heaven' is a construct; አስራብ 'torrents' (plural); አንቅዕት 'springs'; ተርኅወ and ተከሥተ are passives 'were opened', 'were uncovered'; ዘመትሕተ ምድር 'which (is) beneath the earth'.

sentences.t: ወጠፍኡ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እስመ ፡ አረሩ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ መቅሠፍቶሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-perished the-sinners, for they-ripened fruit-of their-scourge;
sentences.i: And the sinners perished, for they had ripened the fruit of their own scourge;
sentences.n: ጠፍኡ 'they perished'. አረሩ is read as 'they brought to ripeness' (አረረ); the verb is uncertain, but the sense 'they reaped the fruit of their punishment' is clear. መቅሠፍት is 'scourge, plague, punishment'; ፍሬ መቅሠፍቶሙ 'fruit-of their-scourge'.

sentences.t: ወኀልቀ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወአራዊት ፡ እስመ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ተፈጥሩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወለክብሩ ፤
sentences.l: And-perished with-them all cattle and-beasts, for all-of-them were-created for joy-of Adam and-for his-glory;
sentences.i: And with them perished all the cattle and wild beasts, for all of them were created for the joy of Adam and for his glory;
sentences.n: ኀልቀ 'came to an end, perished'. እንስሳ 'domestic animals', አራዊት 'wild beasts'. ምስሌሆሙ 'with them'. ተፈጥሩ 'were created'. ፍሥሓ አዳም 'joy-of Adam': the animals exist for man, so they share his fate.

sentences.t: ወቦ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽጋቡ ፡ ወቦ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍሥሓሁ ፡ ወቦ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ አስማት ፡ ለሰብሖ ፡ ፈጣሪሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያእምሮሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-there-is for his-abundance, and-there-is for his-joy, and-there-is that-concerning names, for-praise-of his-creator, that he-know-them;
sentences.i: Some were for his plenty, some for his joy, and some for their names, that he might praise his Creator and come to know them;
sentences.n: ቦ is the existential 'there is (some)'. ጽጋብ 'abundance, plenty'. The last clause alludes to Genesis 2:19-20, Adam naming the animals; ለሰብሖ ፈጣሪሁ 'for the praising of his Creator'. ከመ ያእምሮሙ 'that he know them' is a purpose clause, with the animals as the object. The exact link between naming and praise is my reading.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ አግረርከ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ እገሪሁ ፤
sentences.l: As said David: and-all you-made-subject under his-feet;
sentences.i: As David said: you have put all things under his feet;
sentences.n: Psalm 8:6 (8:7 in the Septuagint and the Ethiopic Psalter): 'You have put all things under his feet'. አግረርከ is 'you subjected' (2nd masc. perfect of አግረረ). ታሕተ እገሪሁ 'under his feet' (እግር, plural እገር, with the suffix). ዳዊት David is cited as the Psalmist.

sentences.t: በእንቲአሁ ፡ ተፈጥሩ ፡ ወበእንቲአሁ ፡ ኀልቁ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ፷ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወአራዊት ፡ በበ፯፯ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወአራዊት ፡ በበ፪፪ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: For-his-sake they-were-created, and-for-his-sake they-perished, except 60 souls; and-from clean cattle and-beasts by-sevens; and-from unclean cattle and-beasts by-twos.
sentences.i: For his sake they were created, and for his sake they perished, except sixty souls; and from the clean cattle and beasts, by sevens; and from the unclean cattle and beasts, by twos.
sentences.n: በእንቲአሁ 'for his sake'. ዘእንበለ ፷ ነፍስ 'except 60 souls': the number is ፷ (sixty) in the source, although the passage clearly means those in the ark (Genesis 7:7, eight persons, which would be ፰); this may be a misreading in the digitization or a variant in the manuscript. I keep what the source gives. በበ፯፯ and በበ፪፪: በበ + a doubled numeral is distributive, 'seven by seven', 'two by two'; the clean animals are by sevens, the unclean by twos, as in Genesis 7:2-3 (whether sevens or seven pairs is not settled by this form). ንጹሕ 'clean', ርኩስ 'unclean'. The ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ run ends the part.
